gallery.title: In the DAW
gallery.caption: MIDI on the track, not a bounce.

features.name: Follow Me
features.subtitle: A second pair of hands.
features.description: Play a line on the keyboard and LucidHarmony voices harmony underneath in real time. Same on-device model as Generate, now following you instead of leading.

features.name: Generate
features.subtitle: A new sequence every click.
features.description: Pick key, model, and richness, then click Generate. Finite bars or Infinite mode. Each pass is a different, musically coherent progression.

features.name: Harmonic Explorer
features.subtitle: Scored alternatives, not a grid.
features.description: Inspect the current sequence, revoice it, and swap chords for scored alternatives. Regenerate as many times as you like without leaving the plugin.

features.name: MIDI export
features.subtitle: From plugin to piano roll.
features.description: Drag a single clip or split voices onto separate tracks. The voicing that sounded right in the plugin is the MIDI that lands in your DAW.

features.name: Presets
features.subtitle: Start closer to the cue.
features.description: Factory presets cover ambient, choral, and cinematic starting points. Save your own once a setting earns a place in the session.

features.name: Intuitive and Advanced
features.subtitle: One plugin, two depths.
features.description: Intuitive keeps the path short: generate, play, drag. Advanced opens voicing, parallel motion, and style controls when the cue needs a tighter hand.

principles.title: On-device, always
principles.description: The AI model runs on your machine. No cloud round-trip to hear a chord.

principles.title: MIDI, not audio
principles.description: LucidHarmony writes notes. Your instruments, your mix, your sound.

principles.title: Theory without homework
principles.description: Voice leading follows counterpoint defaults you can override. You hear the result first.

principles.title: Any DAW, three formats
principles.description: VST3, AU, and CLAP on Windows, Mac, and Linux.

principles.title: One purchase
principles.description: Pay once. Lifetime updates. Install on all the machines you work on.

principles.description: If it does not earn a place in your workflow, Gumroad refunds the license. No questions asked. But we'd love to know why.

benefits: On-device AI, no cloud, your music stays local

faq.q: How is LucidHarmony different from Scaler or Captain Chords?
faq.a: LucidHarmony generates MIDI for ambient and scoring with an on-device transformer, Follow Me, and infinite sequences. Scaler and Captain Chords are theory workstations with analysis and large libraries; this plugin does not replace that job.
No. It is a MIDI effect. Generate or play, then route the MIDI to a software instrument. Silence usually means there is no instrument on the track.
VST3, AU, and CLAP on Windows, Mac, and Linux. Any DAW that hosts those formats.
No. Inference runs on-device. A license check may run at startup; it never disables the plugin.
Buy on Gumroad, enter the key in the About tab. Multiple computers, offline use after first validation. Unlicensed use shows a reminder without blocking features.

faq.q: What if it is not for me?
faq.a: Gumroad offers a 30-day money-back guarantee on the license.
If you need to analyze existing MIDI or browse a chord dictionary, use Scaler. LucidHarmony is for generating and voicing new progressions.
Download from Gumroad, install the VST3, AU, or CLAP, then rescan plugins in your DAW. The docs page has per-DAW paths.
